name: galaxy-mcp
description: Galaxy MCP server (galaxy-mcp) plus the galaxy-connect setup skill.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to a Galaxy server from Codex
interface.longDescription: Runs the galaxy-mcp server (uvx galaxy-mcp) so Codex can list histories, search and run tools, upload data and invoke workflows on your Galaxy server. Reads GALAXY_URL and GALAXY_API_KEY from your environment.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Galaxy and show my recent histories.
Find a Galaxy tool for read trimming and run it.
Check my Galaxy connection is working.
